checks: Exact frozen manifest and both deployment hashes verified; driver copy equals reviewed source; fixture hashes verified.
Mallinfo2 ten size_t fields/order match local glibc malloc.h; all ctypes argtypes/restypes explicit; FILE pointer closed in finally before XML parsing.
malloc_info root totals used once, not added to per-heap totals; glibc malloc metrics explicitly not complete process or TensorFlow/CUDA allocation accounting.
Original five-round soak driver called directly from unchanged base139 runtime; current local ML Python hashes equal frozen base runtime; no hyperparameter overrides or new games.
Normal boundary hooks observe11 before-series/per-round boundaries before any intervention; post-series idle2s, GC, trim ordered once, no per-update flush/reset.
Model/trainer weakrefs must remain alive; model/bothAdam/PCG exact state hashes checked around every probe; globals restored in finally.
Metadata traverses explicit scalar/container histories and weakref shells without following tensor targets; raw smaps and XML streamed to separate files.
Same-inode exclusive lock inherited across launcher and coordinator, held through descendant cleanup and source integrity; finite2700-second diagnostic only.
Exact ownership/pidfd signaling protects reused PIDs; unrelated GPU occupancy refuses launch without signaling unrelated work.
Output created exclusively; original source/checkpoints preserved; one-shot final backup validates gzip,JSON,JSONL,XML and five NPZ CRCs, partial bytes preserved.
Linux and laptop guard cleanup is exact-owner bound; separate authorized Windows day-awake guard remains active.
limitations: RSS growth alone does not establish a leak; decreasing increments do not establish a plateau.
Observation, JSON serialization and state hashing can themselves allocate. Before/after diagnostic snapshots and idle control expose some, not every byte, of this overhead.
malloc_trim return value is not bytes reclaimed. Only measured RSS before/after quantifies resident return; lack of trim response is inconclusive for custom/native allocators.
A post-final trim response cannot justify per-update production trimming or prove natural long-run memory stability.
Saved historical trajectories are a runtime lifecycle diagnostic, not fresh on-policy learning or a learning-strength/throughput claim.
